title: Added component EmptyCart to the cart page
context: A shopper who opened the cart page with nothing in the cart saw one line of text and no link to anywhere else. The page now shows the same line with a link back to the catalogue under it. A cart with items looks as it did before.

- **When** a shopper opens the cart page with no items in the cart, **then** [the page shows "Your cart is empty." and a link "Browse the catalogue"](code:src/routes/cart/components/EmptyCart.tsx#EmptyCart).
- **When** a shopper clicks "Browse the catalogue", **then** [the app goes to `/`](code:src/routes/cart/components/EmptyCart.tsx#L7), the catalogue page.
- **When** a shopper removes the last item on the cart page, **then** [the list gives way to the message and the link](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L8).
- **When** a shopper opens the cart page with items in the cart, **then** nothing changes: the page lists the items and the total.

- Added [``](code:src/routes/cart/components/EmptyCart.tsx#EmptyCart), an exported component with no props that [renders `

Your cart is empty.

`](code:src/routes/cart/components/EmptyCart.tsx#L6) and [a `` with the text "Browse the catalogue"](code:src/routes/cart/components/EmptyCart.tsx#L7), both inside one `
`.

- Modified [``](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#CartPage) to [return `` when `items.length === 0`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L8). It returned `

Your cart is empty.

` before.
